leaves.name: held-receiver-device-events
leaves.replaces: the CUDA events LaneDispatcher._record records on the receiving stage's prefill stream for chunk n's last LAYER, its SUFFIX and its STATE_FINALIZE, and the state_event _do_state_finalize records, while those kernels are still running
leaves.equivalence: the events are r4's ControllableEvent objects the real dispatcher created and recorded; only their host query differs: it answers False (cudaEventQuery's cudaErrorNotReady) until the test releases the hold, by undoing the network's complete_all for exactly these events. The STATE_FINALIZE record's event is the one _after_record hands to channel.consumer_done, so pp_consumer_complete() is False for its real reason and the bridge's report carries no PP_CONSUMER proof. No RPC, reply, RELEASE, receipt or logical acknowledgement is delayed; every other event (stage 0's, the PP receive's, stage 1's PREPARE/PREFIX/first layer) completes at the network's normal rate
leaves.cannot_prove: device timing or that kernels of two chunks run concurrently on the box; the witness shows only which host submissions the engine and workers make while stage 1's late work is incomplete
